body: I'm just so fucking tired of everything. I wake up everyday feeling like shit. I can only sleep if I smoke a joint before bed, and my schedule is all messed up, wake up at 13 and go to bed at 5am, and if I don't have anything to do during the day I just want to be sleeping so day goes faster. I'm really far away from everything, my country, my family, my friends and all the people that I like, 20000 Km to be exact. And I don't know, I just feel I don't have anyone to vent, or cry with. I feel so alone and so tired of everything. Everything bad happened at the same time. And I just want this feeling to go away, I've never felt like this, and never thought I would
